newsitem.title: USA: Coastal Physician Group gets financing.
newsitem.headline: Coastal Physician Group gets financing.

text.p: Coastal Physician Group Inc said Monday it had obtained financing to pay off its outstanding debt to bank lenders and provide working capital.
The physician management company said it had executed a commitment letter with National Century Financial Enterprises Inc.

The letter provides for the purchase of Coastal's eligible healthcare accounts receivable in an aggregate amount of up to $92 million, as well as a secured revolving credit facility of $3.5 million to support letters of credit, it said. National Century will also be able to make loans secured by the accounts receivable, it added.
The company said it expected to close the deal by May 15.
